text: Whenever one has judgment to know good and bad when it is said and done, although he himself may not have the initiative, yet he can recognize the good and the bad in his servant, and the one he can praise and the other correct; thus the servant cannot hope to deceive him, and is kept honest.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXII, Concerning the secretaries of princes
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
